proposal.root_cause: Commit 4a46c09a1a6e37007bc8ecc435df8103a380c441 added PVC redis-data with storageClassName 'fast-ssd', a StorageClass that does not exist in the cluster (only 'standard' exists), leaving the PVC Pending and the redis pod Unschedulable.
proposal.rationale: Pod redis-54db7b8bc-rxt25 is Pending/Unschedulable: 'pod has unbound immediate PersistentVolumeClaims'. The redis-data PVC in demo is Pending with storageClass=fast-ssd, but the cluster only defines the 'standard' StorageClass (rancher.io/local-path), so no PV is ever provisioned. Git history shows commit 4a46c09a1a6e37007bc8ecc435df8103a380c441 ('chore(demo): update redis.yaml') introduced the volumeMount, volumes entry, and the redis-data PVC with storageClassName fast-ssd; the previous known-good revision b5eb80a (still reflected by the healthy old pod redis-5b47f84548) had no PVC/volume, and earlier 'revert redis PVC with non-existent StorageClass' commits (e.g. 64ce566) fixed the identical fault by removing the PVC. Since PVC storageClassName is immutable once the PVC exists in the cluster, changing the class name in git would not repair the already-Pending PVC; reverting commit 4a46c09 (removing volumeMounts, volumes, and the PVC document) is the minimal fix grounded in history and cluster state.
proposal.verify: After the PR merges and Argo CD (demo-app) syncs, the redis Deployment rolls to the spec without the data volume, PVC redis-data is pruned, and pod redis-54db7b8bc-rxt25 (new ReplicaSet) becomes Running/Ready 1/1 with no FailedScheduling events; Argo CD app health returns to Healthy.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/redis.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7-alpine
          args: ["--maxmemory", "32mb", "--maxmemory-policy", "allkeys-lru"]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
          ports:
            - containerPort: 6379
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 6379
            periodSeconds: 5
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 25m
            limits:
              memory: 64Mi
              cpu: 250m
      volumes:
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: redis-data
---
apiVersion: v1

metadata:
  name: redis
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/redis.yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app: redis
  ports:
    - name: redis
      port: 6379
      targetPort: 6379
---

metadata:
  name: redis-data
  namespace: demo
spec:

  storageClassName: fast-ssd

    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
